items.title: Cognizant Hit With Multiple US Class-Action Lawsuits Following TriZetto Data Breach
items.description: Cognizant Technology Solutions is facing multiple class-action lawsuits following a significant data breach at TriZetto Provider Solutions (TPS), its healthcare claims processing subsidiary. The lawsuits, filed in federal courts in New Jersey and Missouri, allege that the company failed to protect sensitive personal information and delayed disclosing the security incident.
